claim: In the Lambda pricing page example with 10 Kafka event source mappings in provisioned mode in US East (N. Virginia), the EPU-hours price is $0.185 per hour and an EPU supports 10 event pollers.
question: In the Lambda pricing example for provisioned mode, what does an EPU-hour cost and how many event pollers does an EPU support?

qualifiers.scope: per EPU-hour; pricing example for Kafka event source mappings in US East (N. Virginia)
qualifiers.condition: pricing example, not a general rate for every event source

evidence.quote: EPU-hours price is $0.185/hour and supports 10 event pollers per EPU.

You created 10 Kafka ESMs for event processing with <1.5 MB/s of throughput per ESM, which you decided to group them under the same Poller group to optimize the costs. Assume that you activated Provisioned Mode for your ESM with the default 1 event poller, and you are using all your 10 ESMs within the same poller group in US East (N. Virginia).

note: adjudicate-18: narrowed to the Kafka pricing example; the 10 pollers per EPU figure is the example's (Kafka) value, and the guide gives SQS and Kafka EPU capacity separately.
